quantitative_anchor: Break-even rebound: 57.8% of gross under simple accounting; 41.7% after 25 kg/MWh LCA; 23.1% after LCA+MRV
current_read: The gross target exceeds current emissions, but lifecycle and credit-integrity filters sharply reduce rebound headroom.
main_failure_mode: Cheap removal delays abatement or induces new emissions.
required_next_proof: A policy and market design that keeps removal additional rather than permissive.

quantitative_anchor: 350 ppm is an imposed management floor; species-level FAIR publication gates still fail
current_read: The reduced-form pathways are screening outputs, not empirical validation of an achievable concentration trajectory.
main_failure_mode: Removal is offset by continued emissions, land/ocean response, and rebound behavior.
required_next_proof: Upgrade the Joos impulse-response screen to FAIR-class or Earth-system modeling.

quantitative_anchor: 100 Gt/y portfolio vs 37.5 Gt/y central assessed potential sum and 107.6 Gt/y high assessed sum
current_read: The portfolio fits only as an upper-tail stress test across several CDR pathways.
main_failure_mode: DACCS, enhanced weathering, ocean alkalinity, BECCS, or biochar misses upper-range deployment.
required_next_proof: Regional cost and potential curves with substitution rules when one pathway under-delivers.

quantitative_anchor: 91,667 TWh/y gross clean generation; 27.5 TW nameplate; 3.5 TW firm clean capacity
current_read: The 3 GJ/tCO2 case is a power-system buildout project at tens-of-terawatts scale.
main_failure_mode: Generation, storage, transmission, interconnection, siting, or firm power falls short.
required_next_proof: Regional dispatch, transmission, storage-duration, and colocation model.

quantitative_anchor: 100 Gt all-air NASEM reference: 3,771 km2 face area; 9,290 TWh/y fan energy; 200,000 STRATOS equivalents
current_read: DAC scale depends on air flow, pressure drop, sorbents, module factories, and maintenance, not only energy price.
main_failure_mode: Contactor pressure drop, fouling, sorbent replacement, or factory throughput dominates the system.
required_next_proof: Factory-rate model for contactor modules, sorbent production, replacement logistics, and autonomous maintenance.

quantitative_anchor: 100 Gt/y gross becomes 84.9 Gt/y 100-year durable credit; 117.8 Gt/y gross required for 100 Gt durable credit
current_read: Gross capture must be overbuilt or route mix must improve to deliver 100 Gt/y durable credited removal.
main_failure_mode: Lifecycle emissions, leakage, reversal, pressure limits, monitoring duration, or liability erodes credit.
required_next_proof: Pathway-specific lifecycle assessment and basin-level storage regionalization.

quantitative_anchor: AETHER automation push: $86/tCO2 and $8.6T/y; deep-abundance floor: $24/tCO2
current_read: AI and robotics can move the automatable buckets, but energy, storage, MRV, finance, materials, and liability remain cost floors.
main_failure_mode: Costs fall in visible labor buckets but not in delivered tonne cost.
required_next_proof: Component-level TEA tied to pathway-specific plant designs and supply chains.

quantitative_anchor: Automation-push P50: 840142 robots/y, 1.55x IFR 2024; 0% pass share
current_read: Legacy fleet arithmetic clears only before field-productivity penalties; autonomous field throughput remains unproven.
main_failure_mode: Humanoid or industrial robot counts do not translate into autonomous field construction, maintenance, drilling, MRV, and logistics.
required_next_proof: Task-family productivity, duty-cycle, reliability, supervision, maintenance, and replacement distributions.

quantitative_anchor: A legacy optimistic case passes; it is not integrated with the later field-productivity, species-emissions, and LCA/MRV gates
current_read: The passing scenario is an upper-tail stress case and should not be read as a validated joint feasibility result.
main_failure_mode: A single binding constraint caps the whole system well below target.
required_next_proof: Integrated scenario model with sourced distributions and correlated assumptions.

quantitative_anchor: 0.75% gross-100 share; 0.09% durable-100 share; median durable credit 30.8 Gt/y
current_read: Current hand-set uncertainty ranges make 100 Gt/y durable credit an upper-tail outcome, not a central forecast.
main_failure_mode: Optimistic assumptions are treated as independent or more evidence-backed than they are.
required_next_proof: Expert elicitation, sourced distributions, correlation structure, and adversarial sensitivity review.

quantitative_anchor: Break-even rebound falls from 57.8% gross to 41.7% after LCA and 23.1% after LCA+MRV in the 25 kg/MWh case
current_read: AETHER must be paired with emissions constraints, sink-use pricing, MRV, liability, and public legitimacy.
main_failure_mode: Removal becomes a permission structure for continued dumping into shared sinks.
required_next_proof: Operational governance model for atmospheric/ocean sink rights, fees, bans, liability, and citizen ownership.
